transport: Pinned unary REST, no implicit retries or fallback, full responses retained

elevenlabs.working_text_limit: 2000 characters across inputs for reliable dialogue generation
elevenlabs.style: sparse inline direction plan required; unqualified freeform style rejected

gemini.request_contract: input user_input/text with speech_metadata annotations; response_format audio; generation_config speech_config
gemini.language: output_language pinned locally; no unsupported language parameter inserted

inworld.format: LINEAR16 WAV, PCM16 or FLAC explicitly

fish.request_contract: application/json and mandatory exact model: drama-3 header
fish.fallback: unknown/missing header rejected by client, contrary response model rejected

minimax.request_contract: stream false, output_format hex, language_boost Russian, explicit audio format
minimax.format: WAV, FLAC or raw PCM16; reported format/rate/channel checked
minimax.style: freeform direction rejected; only supported explicit emotion controls accepted

qualification: Adapter contract tests are not measured voice quality or proof of account access. Live access and listening qualification are separate. No ASR or AudioMaster acceptance is asserted.
